name: Lawsuits Suing
overview: Scripture instructs believers to pursue justice with integrity, avoiding the temptation to follow the majority in wrongdoing or to twist judgments, especially against the vulnerable (Exodus 23:2, 6). It encourages seeking peace and reconciliation quickly with adversaries to prevent escalation into legal disputes and harsh consequences (Matthew 5:25). Wisdom calls for caution before engaging in strife, recognizing the potential for shame and loss (Proverbs 25:8), while trusting that pleasing the Lord can even bring peace with enemies (Proverbs 16:7). The Old Testament principle of just retribution ('an eye for an eye') is acknowledged but is framed within a broader call to righteous conduct and peacemaking (Matthew 5:38).
